title: Target RTO, RPO, and replication lag KPIs

spec.title: Target RTO, RPO, and replication lag KPIs
spec.lead: The two-region Always On architecture enforces sub-minute local failover and bounded cross-region recovery.

items.label: Target: intra-region failover RTO
items.text: Scope: Region 1 Zone A to Zone B automatic promotion · Mechanism: WSFC quorum vote and internal load balancer health probe shift.

items.label: Target: local synchronous RPO
items.text: Scope: Region 1 synchronous-commit pair · Mechanism: primary waits for Zone B transaction log harden before returning commit to clinical app.

items.label: Target: cross-region disaster RTO
items.text: Scope: Region 1 to Region 2 manual promotion · Mechanism: DBA executes forced failover runbook and updates DNS routing for clinical apps.

items.label: Target: cross-region async RPO
items.text: Scope: Region 2 Zone A DR replica · Mechanism: continuous asynchronous log shipping across regions without blocking primary clinical writes.

spec.notes:
Google Cloud reference architecture for Always On Availability Groups achieves an RTO of less than 1 minute and near-zero RPO for intra-region failovers across zones. For healthcare institutions, clinical system downtime requires strict RTO targets under 15 minutes for critical Tier-1 clinical database applications, while asynchronous cross-region replication targets under 5 seconds of RPO.
The times on this slide (1 min, 0 s, 15 min, 5 s) are proposals, not given in the request: confirm them before sharing.

Sources:
[1] Reference Architecture: High-Availability Microsoft SQL Server Databases Using Always On Availability Groups (Google Cloud, 2024) https://cloud.google.com/solutions/sql-server-always-on-availability-groups-compute-engine
[2] Deploying Microsoft SQL Server for Multi-Regional Disaster Recovery (Google Cloud, 2024) https://cloud.google.com/solutions/sql-server-multi-regional-disaster-recovery
[5] Cost of IT Downtime and Enterprise Availability Benchmarks (Gartner, 2021) https://www.gartner.com/en/information-technology
